summary: Complete frontend testing of Guide Overlay 4-tab restructure and Dashboard layout fix. All 17 features tested and passed. Guide now has 4 tabs (Home, Friends and Parties, Games, Messages) with Home as default. Home tab contains Home button, Settings button, Recently Played section with games/Quick Resume badges, and Shutdown System. Dashboard layout fixed with top-games-section grouping Recently Played and extra game slots under title without overlap.

Home tab is default active tab when Guide opens
Home tab shows Home button
Home tab shows Settings button
Home tab shows RECENTLY PLAYED section header
Home tab shows 3 recently played games with cover art
Home tab shows 2 Quick Resume badges on games (Spider-Man, Bionic Commando)
Home tab shows Shutdown System (Exit App) at bottom
Friends and Parties tab shows Friends item
Friends and Parties tab shows platform toggle (Xbox Live/Discord)
Friends and Parties tab shows search input
Games tab shows 3 recently played games with Quick Resume badges
Messages tab shows 'Sign in to view messages' when not logged in

Dashboard: Extra game slots appear below Recently Played

Home button in Guide Home tab navigates to Dashboard Home view and closes Guide
